name: retain-pdf-desktop
description: ReadFlow research library, bilingual reading and PDF translation desktop application

scripts.lint: eslint --max-warnings=0 main.js preload.js src/main scripts/pack-current-asar.mjs scripts/remote-windows.mjs scripts/run-local.mjs scripts/linux-runtime.mjs scripts/linux-runtime.test.mjs scripts/package-readflow-linux.mjs scripts/package-readflow-linux.test.mjs scripts/check-existing-data.mjs
scripts.test: npm run lint && node --test --test-concurrency=2 scripts/runtime-prune.test.mjs scripts/linux-runtime.test.mjs src/main/*.test.mjs scripts/package-readflow-linux.test.mjs
scripts.smoke:frontend-desktop: npm --prefix ../web run smoke:workbench-settings && npm run smoke:frontend-bundle
scripts.verify-frontend-sync: npm run sync-frontend && npm run smoke:frontend-desktop
scripts.prepare-app: npm --prefix ../.. run build:doc && npm --prefix ../web run build && node scripts/prepare-app.mjs
scripts.dist:win32: npm run prepare-app && npm run verify:packaging-deps && electron-builder --win portable --x64 --config.directories.output=win
scripts.dist:win32-installer: npm run prepare-app && npm run verify:packaging-deps && electron-builder --win nsis --x64 --config.directories.output=win
scripts.dist:mac: RETAIN_PDF_BUNDLE_MAC_PYTHON=1 npm run prepare-app && npm run verify:packaging-deps && RETAIN_PDF_BUNDLE_MAC_PYTHON=1 electron-builder --mac dmg --publish never --config.directories.output=mac
scripts.dist:linux: npm run prepare-app && npm run verify:packaging-deps && electron-builder --linux deb --publish never --config.directories.output=linux && npm run verify:linux-runtime

entry.Name: ReadFlow
entry.Comment: Research library, bilingual reading and PDF translation
